answer: Use a Foundry Birth-Certificate Registry. First, each agent submits a signed TPM attestation tying one identity to one serial. Second, the registry stores the hash and rejects repeats. Third, random 90-day audits demand fresh quotes; stale ones are quarantined. Forging 10,000 fakes means 10,000 TPM boards at $45 to $120 ($450K to $1.2M), plus $25 each in fees and labor ($250K), plus months of staging. A jade seal is carved once, never copied; a comet leaves a trail wherever it flies, and at its nadir nothing hides. It works like a passport office that checks the paper, not the photo.
